_comment: SanKey priority framework. Tiers are evaluated top-to-bottom (first match wins). Each tier has a base_priority plus optional modifiers for customer/heat/impact signals. Activity Type field: customfield_12320040.
_guidelines_note: Bug priorities implemented via bug_impact_patterns, story/task priorities via story_impact_patterns (both in area_keywords.json). Patterns evaluated in order; first match wins. Customer signal bumps one level on top. Normal is the base (no pattern needed). Minor detected via cosmetic/alignment/font/text patterns. Severity field represents SanKey company priority band (separate from per-ticket Priority).

Blocker.bug: Completely prevents users from performing a critical function without a workaround.
Blocker.bug_keywords: login fail, white screen, blank page, error page, unusable, complete failure
Blocker.story_keywords: required, must have, mandatory, blocking release
Blocker.epic_note: Story/epic cannot be closed. Address immediately.

Critical.bug: Significantly degrades functionality or compromises important features without a workaround.
bug_examples: Parts of page failing to render
User cannot navigate to or execute critical functionality
Critical.bug_keywords: unable to, cannot, broken, fails to render, crash, failure, not working
Critical.story: Critical to user experience or RH business needs.
Critical.epic_note: Story/epic cannot be closed. Work on immediately once in-progress work completes.

Major.bug: Significant issues affecting important features, but application not unusable. Complex workaround may exist.
Major.bug_keywords: data missing, data incorrect, validation prevents, not showing, doesn't appear, cannot enter/reach
Major.story_keywords: time sensitive, deadline, high priority, needed by
Major.epic_note: Story/epic cannot be closed. Work on in next sprint.

Normal.bug: Issues that affect certain features but are not critical or major. Straightforward workaround exists.
Normal.note: Base priority — assigned when no impact keywords are detected.

Minor.bug: Relatively less significant issues with minimal impact on functionality and UX.
bug_examples: Broken informative link in help popover
Minor.bug_keywords: misalign, alignment, font color, font size, cosmetic, text change, typo, misspell, pixel, whitespace
Minor.story_keywords: cosmetic, text change, font color, alignment, typo
Minor.note: Detected via minor impact patterns in area_keywords.json. Customer bumps to Normal.

sankey_tiers.detect: issuetype=Vulnerability OR label=SecurityTracking OR activity_type='Security & Compliance'

sankey_tiers.description: Technical debt — stability and reliability work
sankey_tiers.detect: feature_label=ui-feature:tech-debt OR existing_labels=tech-debt,tech-maintenance OR activity_type='Quality / Stability / Reliability'

sankey_tiers.description: Bugs not caught by higher tiers. Base Normal per guidelines. Impact keywords bump: blocker→Blocker, critical→Critical, major→Major, minor→Minor. Customer bumps one level.
Stories/Tasks not classified above. Impact keywords from story_impact_patterns bump based on business value language.
